title: fv_nameplate
description: Verbatim transcription of an equipment nameplate photo. Every field is the sentinel string 'none' when it cannot be read with full confidence (schemas cannot union with null). Ratings — voltage, current, kW, HP, RPM, refrigerant charge, pressure, frequency, year — never appear in any field.

manufacturer.description: Brand, logo or company name exactly as printed, or "none" if unreadable or absent.

model.description: Value printed against MODEL / TYPE / CAT NO / PART NO, copied character for character including case, hyphens, slashes and leading zeros, or "none" if unreadable, partial or absent.

serial.description: Value printed against SERIAL / SER NO / S/N, copied character for character, or "none" if unreadable, partial or absent. A partly legible serial is always "none".
